sellCarried.value: floor(EffectiveRate * 250) where EffectiveRate = record.Rate * 1.18^(level-1), FROZEN mutation *0.8 (CarryService.lua:417-429)

sellPets.caps: MAX_SELL_BATCH=50 per request (mirrored client-side); equipped pets refused; dedupe; mid-trade refused; absolute Inventory.Value recompute to repair drift (:261-265)

cucumberRate.model: Deterministic expected cukes/sec vs the HIGHEST unlocked zone's baseline spawn mixture (15 sliced + 24 weighted regular slots), ZONE_HP wall scaling and Door Orbs (Orb*Multi) value scaling, 10% crit x5, pickaxe tick 0.25s + pet tick 0.6s (pet strike = 2 + summed pet Damage, 0 with no pets)
cucumberRate.quote: Quote(sec) = max(1, floor(GetRate * sec)); GetRate = base rate * cucumber multipliers (rebirth, 2x pass, pet Multi1, 2x boost, group +50%). Grant() awards flat (WasPurchase) so multipliers never apply twice.

timeskips.vaultRate: VaultTimeSkipService: coins/sec = sum of CarryService.EffectiveRate over stored vault cucumbers, x coin multipliers (= rebirth); empty vault quotes 0 and Grant refuses (VaultTimeSkipService.lua:30-80)

CURRENTLY DISABLED: MAP_PICKUPS_ENABLED=false (WalkCucumberService.lua:16,294-297)

quests.board: 3 quests: Smash 30-40 breakables, Collect 3-5 chests, Catch 1 specific weight-rolled cucumber type from a random UNLOCKED biome (PRISMATIC catch is a wildcard)

quests.reset: all 3 claimed -> ResetAt = now + 6h; watcher rerolls in-session every 15s once expired; no manual reroll (dev hook only in Studio)

indexAndTrade.indexRewards: Every 5 discovered pets = 1 milestone; claiming milestone N pays 500*N Coins flat (WasPurchase - no multipliers). Unbounded coin faucet scaling with collection size.
indexAndTrade.bossShardForge: 10 shards of a zone's boss forge that boss pet, repeatable (IndexService GetBossShards/ForgeBossPet -> BreakablesService)
indexAndTrade.trade: Pet-only trading, both sides need >= 1 rebirth, max 4 pets per side, equipped pets untradeable, re-validated at execution, selling mid-trade refused. Pets move by id between profiles with absolute PetData writes; Inventory.Value adjusted relatively (drift risk repaired by SellPets' absolute recompute). No currency trading, no dupe path found.

quirksAndRisks: REBIRTH DOUBLE-DIP: 1+0.5R multiplies cucumber earnings AND the vendor's cuke->coin conversion, so farm-loop coins scale ~(1+0.5R)^2 while door/pickaxe prices are static - late-game prices are effectively much cheaper per rebirth (CurrencyHandler.lua:76-99).
MAX_REBIRTHS=50 is unreachable in practice: cost 100k*3.5^R passes 27B coins at R10 and ~4.6e31 at R49; the vault tower floors 5-6 (rebirth 35-45) are effectively decorative.

DOOR BACKFILL: buying any later door grants ALL earlier doors free (DoorService.lua:163-171) - skipping Desert/Samurai (34k combined) by saving 1M for Farm is possible but rebirth gates keep order roughly intact; join-time backfill also repairs old skipped saves.
QUEST COIN FLOOR: every quest claim pays >= 500 Coins even with an empty vault (QuestBoardService.lua:43,134-136) - a small guaranteed faucet, up to 1500/6h at zero effort beyond quest completion.

STARTER PORTAL PROGRESS WIPE: StarterPortalService calls PortalProgress.Reset inside loadCooldown (join, :118) instead of startCooldown like the other four portals (e.g. SnowPortalService.lua:125) - Starter smash progress (18) is wiped on EVERY join, defeating its DataStore persistence; likely a bug.

SELLCARRIED REBIRTH BONUS: carried-cucumber sale (Rate*1.18^(L-1)*250) also gets the rebirth coin multiplier (no MultipliersApplied flag, SellVendorServer.lua:126) - vault display cards show the flat value, so paid amount exceeds the shown green number at R>0.

MINT-GUARD NOTES ALREADY IN CODE: SellPets is a two-pass yield-free design with absolute inventory recompute because client-reachable PetService.DeletePet decrements across a yield (free pet-storage drift, SellVendorServer.lua:255-265); leaderstats.Changed mirrors straight to profile, so ANY server-side leaderstat write persists instantly (InstanceValues.lua:47-55).

TIMESKIP QUOTES INCLUDE MULTIPLIERS: minigame cucumber prizes, quest cucumber halves, and Robux time skips all scale with rebirth/pets/gamepass/group multipliers - a 1-week time skip (604800s) at late-game rates is an enormous grant; quotes are deterministic and locked at pick time so spinner-time equipment swaps cannot inflate them.

PET EQUIPS CLAMP MISMATCH: InstanceValues clamps board 'Pet equips' to 0..6 (InstanceValues.lua:125) while the dictionary caps board progression at 3 (MAX_PET_EQUIPS-4, Dictionaries__Upgrades.lua:57) - harmless today (MaxUpgrade=3) but a trap if MaxUpgrade rises.
VaultTimeSkips products are Id=0 placeholders - the second time-skip product line is wired but not sellable yet (ProductController.lua:236-243).
WalkCucumberService map pickups are disabled (MAP_PICKUPS_ENABLED=false) - dead code kept; quest/minigame time-skips are the only remaining pickup-style faucets.
